div.font: (1) SUM formulas calculate total debits ($2,847,362.50) and total credits ($2,847,362.50) across all GLEntry rows. (2) The difference of $0.00 confirms that the Charles River general ledger satisfies the fundamental accounting equation. A nonzero difference would indicate a serious consistency problem.
